notes.title: UI Update
notes.content:
Simple Update:

Fixes for Ui Placements on different Screen Sizes.

RRC:
Should have the right placements for wider/smaller screens.
Reaching the Checkpoint, if you lose, doesn't repeat the whole intro.

notes.title: More Fixes
notes.content:
Hi. It's been awhile, you & me.
More people have been playing, and I noticed some bugs in their stream/videos.

Bug Fixes:

[b]Split Screen:[/b]
Added a Mic Sensitivity Slider in options.

[b]Just a Peep:[/b]
Opening the sliding door Distance increased at the end.......Just in case.

[b]Intermission:[/b]
Choosing 2 symbols actually negated the watcher's attack. Which was funny, but no cheating allowed gosh darn it.

[b]Repeat:[/b]
When the Hide event happens, if the player clicks o the screen, it disables you from typing. Fixed, but
Have not tested if it still works on multiscreens setups though.
[i]Just don't click okay![/i]
Other Small improvements.

Checkpoints were added in the halfway points as well on, 
[b]Repeat & Intermission.[/b]

:)

Hopefully I didn't break anything!
Ah I got a tiny horror game coming out soon.
Bye bye!

Super small 

[h1]Patch Notes:[/h1]

-Removed Steam VR Pop up!
-[b]dont look up[/b]: volume increased slightly in the intro!

that's it!

notes.title: Subtitles Unleashed!
notes.content:
Well! I lied! I said 2 weeks, it took 2 days!

[h1]English [b]SUBTITLES[/b] is [b]OUT!!!![/b][/h1]

It's enabled automatically, but you may disable it!
I fixed some bugs too!

[h1]Patch Notes:[/h1]

[b]Intermission[/b]: 
[olist]
[*] Not a bug, BUT being able to see those [b]2[/b] words that were cut off is a bit important!
[/olist]

[b]I Think I Hit Something[/b]:
[olist]
[*] Improved the car acceleration at the end!
[/olist]

Sheep's Gun:
[olist]
[*] Player's die if they kill a Ghost before the body cam is back to normal.. You people were too Trigger Happy, so you're unable to do that now! ;D Fixed.
[*] Fixed Animation Trigger if Ghost receives a headshot while attacking!
[*] Unable to shoot or reload on scenes deemed not needed.
[/olist]


Let me know if a word is misspelled or subtitles don't work!!!!
I'm the only one testing right now!

Thank you!!!! Spread the love around!!! :)

notes.title: Thank you and Subtitles
notes.content:
Hey all! Game's starting to get traction O_O 
I hope everyone appreciates the weird and scary work I put out. Hopefully proving my worthy-ness in making horror games. I hope you all share and tell people, it will really help out in making my next games. Vol. 2?

Well, some people have been asking for this!
[h3]
[b]I will be looking into adding English subtitles[/b][/h3]

Should be added in the next 2 weeks, I'll try my best to add it as soon as I can!

Thank you all!

*hugs*

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.content:
I was notified about 3 bugs that weren't squashed before release!!
Patch out now! Let me know if you find any! There shouldn't be any ground breaking ones anymore!

[h1]Patch Notes:[/h1]

Able to Reload after Cinematic Scene in a Sheep's Gun.
Plays the missing Intro of a Sheep's Gun.
Fixed Progression Bug in Alone//White Canvas.
Made rotation of cards easier to see in Intermission.
